ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on distal lobes to low-intensity black pixels in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions on the outer lateral lobes; central high-contrast black region extending from the notch to the baseline. Distal right lobe contains a high-density cluster of small, low-intensity circular spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees and a significant vertical indentation depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (3px to 15px) along the entire trailing edge; notably jagged macro-structures on the upper margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave upward sweep from the lower central insertion point to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white rings scattered across the central black pigmentation. A dense cluster of dark circular spots localized on the right white lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four distinct horizontal parallel linear marks (rake-like) on the right inner lobe; one vertical linear mark on the left white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular erosion and jagged tissue loss across the trailing edge boundary; presence of multiple circular scarring patterns throughout the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-relief, clustered geometric protrusions on the extreme lateral tips, consistent with active barnacle colonization.
